Input Mesh File.description: Mesh file, relative to the input deck

Node Sets.description: Named node sets: a node id, ids separated by spaces, a range "1:10", a .txt file with node ids, a condition on x, y, z (e.g. "x < 0.1") or "All"; Exodus meshes bring their own node sets

Normal X.description: x component of the normal of the filter plane

Normal Y.description: y component of the normal of the filter plane

Normal Z.description: z component of the normal of the filter plane (3D only)

Center X.description: x coordinate of the disk center

Center Y.description: y coordinate of the disk center

Center Z.description: z coordinate of the disk center (3D only)

Lower Left Corner X.description: x coordinate of the lower left corner of the rectangle

Lower Left Corner Y.description: y coordinate of the lower left corner of the rectangle

Lower Left Corner Z.description: z coordinate of the lower left corner of the rectangle (3D only)

Bottom Unit Vector X.description: x component of the direction of the rectangle's bottom edge

Bottom Unit Vector Y.description: y component of the direction of the rectangle's bottom edge

Bottom Unit Vector Z.description: z component of the direction of the rectangle's bottom edge (3D only)

Bottom Length.description: Length of the rectangle along the bottom unit vector

Side Length.description: Length of the rectangle perpendicular to the bottom edge

Allow Contact.description: Keeps the filtered bonds as contact bonds so the two sides cannot penetrate each other

additionalProperties.description: Removes the bonds crossing a disk or rectangle, e.g. to model a pre-crack

Overwrite Mesh.description: Regenerate the mesh from the G-code; if false and the .txt mesh written by a previous run exists next to the G-code file, that mesh is read instead

Sampling.description: Distance between two nodes along a printed path; quantity: length (in your consistent unit system)

Width.description: Width of the printed strand; with sampling and height it sets the node volume; quantity: length (in your consistent unit system)

Height.description: Layer height of the printed strand; with sampling and width it sets the node volume; quantity: length (in your consistent unit system)

Start Command.description: Comma-separated G-code commands that switch node generation on; without it every extruding move creates nodes

Stop Command.description: Comma-separated G-code commands that switch node generation off; needs a start command

End Command.description: G-code command that ends reading the file

Blocks.description: Block id => condition on the node position x, y, z (e.g. "z > 2.0"); a node gets the last block whose condition holds, block 1 otherwise

Gcode.description: Generates the mesh from a G-code file by sampling the printed paths

Influence Function.description: Weight of each bond as a function of its length xi (or xiX, xiY, xiZ), e.g. "1/xi^2"; all bonds weigh 1 if not given

Direction.description: Axis along which the mesh is extended on both sides

Step_X.description: Node spacing along the extrusion direction; quantity: length (in your consistent unit system)

Step_Y.description: Node spacing across the extrusion direction in the x-y plane; quantity: length (in your consistent unit system)

Step_Z.description: Node spacing of the added nodes in z (3D only); quantity: length (in your consistent unit system)

Number.description: Number of node layers added on each side

Surface Extrusion.description: Adds two blocks of regularly spaced nodes on both sides of the mesh, e.g. as load introduction

File.description: File with one element per line, listing the node numbers of the element

Add Neighbor Search.description: Keeps the peridynamic neighbors of nodes in finite elements in addition to the element neighbors

Input External Topology.description: Finite element topology read from a separate file, for FEM or coupled FEM/PD meshes

Horizon Mesh Scaling X.description: Factor on the horizon in x for the neighbor search, for elliptic neighborhoods

Horizon Mesh Scaling Y.description: Factor on the horizon in y for the neighbor search, for elliptic neighborhoods

Horizon Mesh Scaling Z.description: Factor on the horizon in z for the neighbor search, for elliptic neighborhoods

Distribution Type.description: How nodes are split across MPI ranks: "Neighbor based", "Node based", or any other value for an even split by node number

Discretization.description: Mesh input: the point cloud or mesh file, node sets, bond filters and the neighbor search

Block ID.description: Block id of the nodes in the mesh file

Density.description: Mass density of the block; quantity: density (in your consistent unit system)

Horizon.description: Radius of the neighborhood in which a node interacts with other nodes; quantity: length (in your consistent unit system)

Material Model.description: Name of an entry in Material Models

Damage Model.description: Name of an entry in Damage Models; no damage if not given

Thermal Model.description: Name of an entry in Thermal Models

Specific Heat Capacity.description: Heat capacity per unit mass; required with thermal models

Additive Model.description: Name of an entry in Additive Models

Degradation Model.description: Name of an entry in Degradation Models

Pre Calculation Model.description: Name of an entry in Pre Calculation Models

additionalProperties.description: Time range, solver and the model categories evaluated in a solver step

Multistep Solver.description: Several solver steps run one after another, one entry per name, each with its own Step ID; use either this or Solver

Output Filename.description: Name of the result file without extension

Output File Type.description: File format; CSV holds only the compute class values

Output Variables.description: Field and compute class names to write (true) or skip (false)

Output Frequency.description: Writes every n-th step; per solver step as "n1 n2"; give this or Number of Output Steps, which takes precedence

Number of Output Steps.description: Number of outputs, evenly spread over the solver steps; per solver step as "n1 n2"; give this or Output Frequency; wins if both are given

Start Time.description: No output before this time; quantity: time (in your consistent unit system)

End Time.description: No output after this time; quantity: time (in your consistent unit system)

Write After Damage.description: Starts writing only once damage has occurred

Flush File.description: Closes the file after every output so it can be read while the simulation runs

Bond Export.description: Writes the bonds as line elements so bond fields can be visualized; switched on automatically when a bond field is requested

Bond Blocks.description: Blocks whose bonds are exported: a block id or ids separated by spaces, e.g. "1 3"; all blocks if not given

Fallback Output Frequency.description: Writes every n-th step of a fallback solver; per solver step as "n1 n2"; Fallback Number of Output Steps takes precedence; without either the output keeps its interval in time

Fallback Number of Output Steps.description: Number of outputs over the steps of a fallback solver; per solver step as "n1 n2"; wins over Fallback Output Frequency

x-perilab-required-groups.description: give one of Output Frequency, Number of Output Steps

additionalProperties.description: A result file with the fields and compute classes to write and when to write them

Outputs.description: Result files, one entry per name

Compute Class.description: Where the value is taken: a block, a node set or the node nearest to a point

Variable.description: Field the value is computed from, e.g. "Forces" or "Displacements"

Calculation Type.description: Reduction over the nodes; without it a node set exports every node separately

Equation.description: Expression in x applied to the computed value x, e.g. "-x" or "x/2"

additionalProperties.description: A global value computed from a field over a block, a node set or the node nearest to a point, for the outputs

Compute Class Parameters.description: Global values for the outputs, one entry per name; the name is used in Output Variables

Degree.description: Polynomial degree of the elements: one value, or one per direction separated by spaces

Material Model.description: Name of the entry in Material Models used by the finite elements

PD Weight.description: Arlequin weight in the coupling zone: forces of the coupled finite element nodes are scaled by this value, those of the coupled peridynamic nodes by one minus it

Kappa.description: Stiffness of the coupling between peridynamic nodes and finite elements

Coupling Block.description: Block id of the coupling zone; without it every peridynamic node inside an element is coupled

Coupling.description: Coupling between the finite element and the peridynamic region

FEM.description: Finite elements for the nodes of the external topology, optionally coupled to peridynamics

Update.description: Recomputes the correction in every step, so cracks and added material change the surface

Surface Correction.description: Corrects the missing neighbors of nodes near free surfaces

Strict Validation.description: Unknown keys are errors; false reports them as warnings
